additions.name: Atlas UI 3
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted multi-provider chat interface with MCP tools and agentic workflows, developed at Sandia National Laboratories.

additions.name: ENZO
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted AI workspace with chat, agents, and skills using your own provider keys or an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint.

additions.name: vimin-core
additions.tooltip: Distributed local LLM and Whisper inference orchestration with MLX and llama.cpp backends and an HTTP API.

additions.name: LLMKube
additions.tooltip: Kubernetes operator for llama.cpp inference with model management, GPU support, Helm deployment, and an OpenAI-compatible API.

additions.name: CorvinOS
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted assistant connecting Ollama and other model providers to messaging platforms, with consent controls and audit logging.

additions.name: OpenAgent
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted AI assistant with local-model support, knowledge bases, agent tools, and workflow automation.

additions.name: llm-swarm-router
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted LAN mesh router for local LLM backends, exposing OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs.

additions.name: Routerly
additions.tooltip: Self-hosted OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway with routing policies, cost tracking, and budget enforcement.
